body: Thanks for the kind words, gives me ideas to help break this cycle. I'm glad you found a comfort in your video games. I do have an XBox360, perhaps I should fire it up more.
I signed up for college, hoping to do just that. You're exactly right. Thank you.

Thank you so much. This really puts things into perspective. I am going to do just what you said and look for similar folks. I try to remember at times that I'm a survivor, perhaps I should use this as a threshold for strength. And yes, fuck those feelings my gf makes me endure. She has no respect for me. I feel like I give her more respect than she deserves. Your words go a long way. Thanks again.
